thread:
jena: Heads-up — joint GTM check. CloudBundle + NVIDIA HW partner + two SI integrators have a soft launch window next Tue. We need: press embargo assets, final landing page copy, marketplace SKU mapping, and SI connector signoff. Who can pick what?

matt: I’ll own SKU mapping & pricing matrix. Will push spreadsheet to the drive by EOD Fri.

olivia: I can do landing page + hero asset placement. Need partner logos (SVG) and one hero screenshot or short gif. Can someone ping partner design?

samir: SI side here — finishing connector README and test harness. Link: https://git.redwood/internal/si/connectors/cloudbundle. Plan to run full integration tests tomorrow AM.

eve: Legal check — embargo window ok, but we need partner-approved quote language and trademark approvals by Monday. Please tag me when you have final copy.

jena: @olivia can you draft the top-of-page headline and CTA? We should align on the press quote we ask partners to approve.

olivia: Draft headline: "Redwood Inference + NVIDIA: Low-latency marketplace bundles for production LLMs". CTA: "Get started on marketplace" — happy to iterate.

matt: Pricing note: marketplace SKUs will map to Dedicated / Hosted tiers. I’ll include fallback mapping for customers wanting private deploy.

samir: Smoke test command for SI connector: `./scripts/smoke-test --env staging --connector nimbus-sql --run-fast` — runs the basic auth + inference flow. Please run before we cut the listing.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded: marketplace-bundle v1.5 (build #1023) — smoke-deploy passed on staging.

jena: Excellent. Two quick asks: 1) Olivia, share copy draft by EOD Thu so legal/partner can review. 2) Samir, run smoke-test and paste results here when done.

samir: Running now... quick log: `OK 200 POST /infer (latency 120ms)`, connector auth ok. Will do full run and upload artifacts.

eve: Once Olivia posts final copy, tag me @eve and I’ll request partner approvals. Also cc partner-ops for logo files.

olivia: Uploaded draft copy + hero placeholder: https://drive.redwood/gs/marketplace/hero-draft. Please comment.

matt: Uploaded SKU spreadsheet v1 to the same drive folder. Added a notes tab for migration mapping.

samir: Full test artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/builds/1023/artifacts. All green except a flap on longer seqs (investigating).

jena: Thanks all. Contingency plan if partner can't approve quote by Mon: we can soft-list a "coming soon" entry with waitlist CTA and delay press. Ping product-ops if we need to flip the toggle. :thumbsup:

matt: Noted. I'll add a column in the spreadsheet for "press-ready" boolean so we can filter.

olivia: Will update hero with partner-approved logo once I get files.

samir: FYI I’ll run another nightly smoke and alert if regressions.

jena: Final sync tomorrow 10:30 PT — quick stand to confirm approvals and deploy window. Thanks everyone.
